== English Reflections II comparison ==
The physical Reflections III foil repeats the original Reflections II text. The Advanced Rulebook 2.0 already publishes the full replacement, making the loss act before theft and using ‘may not be Disarmed’. The later marked rendering writes ‘present here’ where the earlier replacement says ‘present’. The underlying location requirement, eligible unique lightsaber, weapon destiny cancellation and drain protection are retained.
